title.zh: 将第670号共和国法第1条杂项 A 编（A）款 Batangas 项下公共工程项目的某些拨款予以调拨的法案
title.en: An Act Transferring Certain Appropriations for Public Works Projects Under the Heading "Batangas," Subsection (A), Title "A. Miscellaneous," Section One of Republic Act Numbered Six Hundred Seventy
title.orig: An Act Transferring Certain Appropriations for Public Works Projects Under the Heading "Batangas," Subsection (A), Title "A. Miscellaneous," Section One of Republic Act Numbered Six Hundred Seventy

text.en:
Sub-heading "Other Public Works Projects," under the heading "Batangas," subsection (a), Title "A. Miscellaneous," section one of Republic Act Numbered Six hundred seventy, is amended by increasing the appropriation for items numbers fourteen and twenty-three and eliminating items seventeen and twenty-one.
"14. Repair of Mapalad-na-bato Parents-Teachers Association School Building, Nasugbu Pl.000.00 "23. Repair Bulihan Parents-Teachers Association School Building, Nasugbu P1,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 20, 1953.
